question: Among all posts that were last active on '2010-07-19', what percentage were created by users whose accounts were also created in 2010? Only consider posts with a non-null OwnerUserId.

prediction.sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', u.XCL_054) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS percentage
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE p.XCL_034 LIKE '2010-07-19%'
  AND p.XCL_033 IS NOT NULL
